name: toast
title: Toast
description: Sonner-shaped toast (`toast.message/success/error/promise`) rendered as one joined 320px panel, bottom-right, on the inverse surface. One-line rows open on hover/focus/tap; errors arrive open and never auto-dismiss. Render one <Toaster /> inside your .ds scope. Uses the .ds-inverse scope, --destructive-text and the ds-toast-* keyframes from ds-theme.
